Hi Rishi — thanks for the demo last week. We liked Redwood’s latency and the routing controls; the team asked whether Novapulse can be on a quarterly invoicing cadence instead of monthly. Two constraints on our side:

- Finance only processes vendor payments on a quarterly schedule (internal policy)
- Novapulse prefers invoices to be held in escrow until usage reconciliation is complete to avoid overpaying during pilot bursts

Is Redwood open to quarterly billing with an escrow arrangement (third-party escrow release after reconciliation)? If so we can route SOW approval quicker. We can sign a simple escrow release form while legal reviews more detailed terms.

Attachments: Novapulse_Payment_Policy.pdf (sent separately)

Appreciate a quick confirmation — Marta

Marta — thanks, and glad the demo landed well. Short answer: we can accommodate quarterly invoicing for pilots, but we need executive signoff for the non-standard cadence and an acceptable risk mitigation for delayed cash flow. Options we typically consider:

1) Letter of credit or escrow with release after usage reconciliation (preferred)
2) Net-90 payment terms with a 10% holdback until reconciliation
3) Upfront nominal deposit plus quarterly settlement

I'll loop in Finance (Laura) and Deal Desk (Marissa) to scope the operational and legal steps. Could you share the escrow provider name Novapulse prefers? If not, EscrowTrust is acceptable and we can run a short form agreement.

I'll prepare an exec request outlining ARR impact and proposed controls for signoff.

Thanks for the ping, Rishi. Drafted a short risk summary and required safeguards for an escrow-based quarterly cadence: 

- Business case: estimated ARR from pilot → $120k annualized if pilot converts; Q1 recognized revenue delay of ~3 months
- Risk to Redwood: delayed cashflow and reconciliation mismatch (we may under- or over-recognize usage)
- Proposed controls:
  • Use a neutral escrow agent (EscrowTrust suggested) to hold invoices for 45 days post-quarter for reconciliation
  • Require monthly usage reports from Novapulse; final reconciliation at quarter close
  • Redwood retains right to charge catch-up invoice if usage exceeds estimate; escrow releases only after mutual reconciliation or arbitrated release clause
  • No price concession required; however request short-term credit holdback of 5% for first quarter

We need exec approval from Sales Leadership to accept: (A) quarterly cadence with escrow, (B) temporary 45-day escrow hold period, (C) 5% holdback on first quarter (applied to cashflow modeling), and (D) ability to revert to monthly upon renewal.

I attached the one-pager risk assessment and a temp escrow template for legal to start redlines.

Laura
Finance — Redwood Inference

Subject: ACTION: Exec approval request — Novapulse quarterly invoicing w/ escrow (deal D-58912-EX)

Marissa / Karthik / Markus — requesting quick executive signoff for the non-standard payment terms Novapulse is asking for on the attached pilot SOW. Summary and ask below.

Summary:
- Account: Novapulse (prospective pilot; SOC/infra review complete)
- ARR upside (if converted): $120k run-rate
- Ask from customer: Quarterly invoicing cadence (vendor policy) + escrow hold until reconciliation
- Proposed Redwood terms:
  1) Accept quarterly invoicing for pilot only; revert to standard cadence on renewal unless mutually agreed
  2) Use EscrowTrust as neutral agent; escrow release 45 days after quarter close following reconciliation
  3) Redwood to retain right to invoice for incremental usage discovered in reconciliation; escrow funds used to satisfy catch-up if needed
  4) 5% holdback on first quarter to offset cashflow risk (apply as short-term credit, not a discount)

Business rationale for approval:
- Faster procurement on Novapulse side — unlocking immediate pilot signature and early usage data (high chance to convert)
- Minimal revenue at risk (~$30k for first quarter; protected via escrow + 5% holdback)
- Preserves pricing integrity (no discount requested)

Attachments included: Novapulse_SOW_Q4.pdf, Escrow_Temp_Agreement.docx, Novapulse_Invoicing_Schedule.xlsx (draft)

Decision requested by EOD Mon Jan 4 (need to send an agreed SOW and escrow form to Novapulse to meet their procurement window). Proposed approval language: 

"Approved: Redwood accepts quarterly invoicing for Novapulse pilot under escrow with a 45-day post-quarter release and a 5% holdback on first quarter. Legal to finalize escrow agreement and Deal Desk to update SOW."

If you prefer alternate safeguards (LOC instead of escrow, different holdback percentage), say so and we can present the tradeoffs to Novapulse this week.

Thanks — and happy new year to all —
Rishi
